changeSet.sql: update financial_transaction set transaction_ingestion_id = null where transaction_ingestion_id in ( select id from transaction_ingestion where ingestion_type = 'FILE' )

delete from rel_transaction_candidate__tags where transaction_candidate_id in ( select id from transaction_candidate where transaction_ingestion_id in (select id from transaction_ingestion where ingestion_type = 'FILE') or ingestion_record_id is not null )

delete from transaction_candidate_tag_suppression where transaction_candidate_id in ( select id from transaction_candidate where transaction_ingestion_id in (select id from transaction_ingestion where ingestion_type = 'FILE') or ingestion_record_id is not null )

delete from transaction_candidate_input_issue where transaction_candidate_id in ( select id from transaction_candidate where transaction_ingestion_id in (select id from transaction_ingestion where ingestion_type = 'FILE') or ingestion_record_id is not null )
delete from transaction_candidate where transaction_ingestion_id in (select id from transaction_ingestion where ingestion_type = 'FILE') or ingestion_record_id is not null
